title: Grateful Dead Live at Curtis Hixon Convention Hall on 1973-12-19
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Sound Devices 744T -> Samplitude Professional v10.2 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard transfer of a killer 1973 Tampa show highlighted by a superb Here Comes Sunshine and an earth‑shaking Other One.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this December 19, 1973 performance at Curtis Hixon Hall, calling it one of the best ’73 shows with a standout Here Comes Sunshine, tight Playin’ in the Band, and a monster The Other One. The board transfer is praised as clear and well‑balanced, though one reviewer notes that Phil’s solo before The Other One wasn’t patched into this version.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for both the musical performance and the soundboard quality; only minor criticism about a missing solo patch.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, well‑balanced board mix praised by multiple reviewers; transfer noted as great. The only technical comment is that Phil’s solo before The Other One was not patched in.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set lauded for its energy and tightness, second set builds to a dramatic climax with The Other One; overall pacing described as one of the better first sets of 1973.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil's solo before The Other One is missing (not patched) in this transfer.
